en.field.compactionInstruction.desc: The instruction sent to the model when a summary is generated
en.field.compactionInstruction.help: This instruction is sent along with the conversation when compacting, telling the model what the summary must cover; customize it as you like. The default is a Chinese eight-section skeleton.
en.field.compactionInstruction.placeholder:
Current task:
Done:
To do:
Key decisions:
Files involved:
Errors and fixes:
User preferences:
Next step:
en.field.compactionInstruction.title: Summary instruction
en.field.compactionScope.help: Once the master switch is on, which sessions compaction applies to. All compacts both the main agent and subagents; Main only leaves subagents untouched; Subagents only leaves the main agent untouched. Defaults to All.
en.field.compactionScope.title: Compaction scope
en.field.compactionThreshold.desc: Compaction starts once the context grows to this size
en.field.compactionThreshold.help: Accepts forms such as 1M / 200K / 100000: K means 1000 and M means 1000000, case-insensitive. It must be a positive integer.
en.field.compactionThreshold.invalid: Invalid threshold; enter a value such as 200K or 100000
en.field.compactionThreshold.title: Trigger threshold
en.field.retryCount.desc: How many times to retry when a network request is interrupted; applies to every provider
en.field.retryCount.help: How many extra attempts the plugin makes after the official retries run out. 0 disables it; range 0 to 99.
en.field.retryCount.invalid: Retry count must be an integer between 0 and 99
en.field.retryCount.title: Network retry count
en.field.retryTokens.desc: Only these codes or HTTP statuses are retried by the plugin
en.field.retryTokens.help: Comma-separated; mix failure codes (SERVER, RATE_LIMIT, TIMEOUT, TRANSPORT) with HTTP statuses (502, 429). Empty means no failure is retried.
en.field.retryTokens.title: Failures that trigger a retry
en.field.toolFailurePrefixes.help: When a tool call fails, the platform writes a warning into the model reply. Enter the fixed beginning of that warning here; the reply is matched as a whole against the start. Empty = no warning is matched and the rule stays off. Case-sensitive.
en.field.toolFailurePrefixes.hint: Fixed prefixes only, one per line
en.field.toolFailurePrefixes.title: Failure warning prefixes
en.header.name: DSH Optimize
en.nudge.emptyTurn: DSH Optimize: the turn ended without a reply; the model was asked to add one (attempt {p1})
en.nudge.toolFailure: DSH Optimize: a tool call failed; the model was asked to retry (attempt {p1})
en.progress.held: Subagent completion notices are held back ({p1} so far) and delivered together once every subagent has finished
en.repair.desc: Scans every session file and repairs known kinds of damage so unreadable sessions work again
en.repair.done: Scanned {p1} sessions: {p2} intact, {p3} repaired, {p4} unrepairable, {p5} read-failed
en.repair.help: Known kinds of damage make the platform reject a whole session file: a broken retry chain (repeated or skipped retry numbers, or mismatched ids within one chain) and event-sequence range encodings. One click scans every session file, repairs what it can, and skips the rest.
en.repair.title: Repair broken sessions
en.retryIntercept.corrected: Plugin intervention: retry-chain sequence corrected ({p1} in this turn)
en.rule.backgroundJobTool.desc: Creates a tool wired to pwsh, letting the model run long commands in the background without blocking the turn
en.rule.backgroundJobTool.help: When on, the model can start background commands with the job_background tool and manage them with job_list / job_output / job_kill. When off, the tool disappears from the tool list.
en.rule.backgroundJobTool.title: Background task tool
en.rule.contextCompaction.desc: Condenses an earlier stretch of the conversation into a summary as it grows, freeing up context
en.rule.contextCompaction.help: When the conversation reaches the trigger threshold, the plugin has the model condense an earlier stretch into a summary and continues from that summary instead of the original text, freeing context for what follows. The kept amount is fixed at 30% of the threshold, and the summary model follows the current session.
en.rule.contextCompaction.title: Automatic context compaction
en.rule.emptyOutputGuard.desc: Fixes the model ending a turn with only reasoning and no reply to the user.
en.rule.emptyOutputGuard.help: When the model only thinks in its last step and neither replies to the user nor calls a tool, the turn is pulled back one step and the model is asked to state its result clearly.
en.rule.emptyOutputGuard.title: Turn ends without a reply
en.rule.networkRetry.desc: Fixes a failed turn when the official retry budget runs out during a network interruption.
en.rule.networkRetry.help: After the official retries are exhausted, the plugin adds a few more attempts for the failure kinds listed below, giving transient faults such as 502, rate limits, timeouts and broken streams another chance.
en.rule.networkRetry.title: Continue after a network interruption
en.rule.retryIntercept.desc: Fixes the case where a session suddenly refuses to open while subagents are running.
en.rule.retryIntercept.help: The platform validates retry chains only when reading a session; the write path has no gate. This rule adds one on the write path and is always on. A light note appears at the turn tail whenever a correction happens.
en.rule.retryIntercept.title: Automatic repair for broken subagent sessions
en.rule.subagentAggregation.desc: When several subagents finish in parallel, their notices are held back and delivered together as one message once every subagent is done, instead of waking the model one by one
en.rule.subagentAggregation.help: Off by default. While it is on, user messages still go through during the wait; reloading the plugin discards held notices that have not been delivered yet.
en.rule.subagentAggregation.title: Aggregate subagent notices
en.rule.toolFailureGuard.desc: Fixes the conversation stopping abruptly when a tool call fails.
en.rule.toolFailureGuard.help: When a tool call the model issued did not run and the framework still treats the turn as complete, a note is injected so the model retries instead of the conversation stopping silently.
en.rule.toolFailureGuard.title: Continue after a failed tool call
